title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta3

## Vendor-current-state alignment beta

This beta deliberately changes the current-map semantics discovered during the
0.5 canonical shadow migration. The current map now follows fresh Navimow vendor
state instead of preserving older local percentages after the vendor has reset a
zone.

The matching frontend prerelease is **Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta3**.

## Current zone progress

- Fresh private-cloud `get-path-info-time` coverage is the current-map
  authority.
- If Navimow changes a zone from 100% or 69% to 0%, the current map also shows
  0%. Local monotonic completion/progress history no longer keeps that zone
  visually green.
- Stale/missing vendor coverage still keeps the last known good value; only a
  fresh vendor observation may move current progress backwards.
- Historical `last_completed_*` metadata remains retained separately in
  History.

## Current trail lifetime

- A fresh vendor 0% reset removes that zone's current VendorTrailStore geometry,
  even when the vendor start timestamp has not changed yet.
- A reset checkpoint prevents a lagging compressed trail response from
  resurrecting the old pre-reset prefix.
- When the vendor appends new points after the reset, only the new suffix is
  adopted. If the vendor rewrites the route instead, the rewritten current
  geometry is adopted.
- Vendor-zero zones are also suppressed from the History fallback so old route
  geometry cannot immediately reappear on the current map.

## Mowed means cutting

- Current-cycle History fallback keeps only cutting points. Travel/return points
  are split out instead of being joined into long straight lines toward the
  dock.
- Vendor MQTT live tails were already cutting-only; this beta makes the fallback
  path follow the same rule.

## Task lifecycle

- Docked/charging mowers no longer keep retained session zone membership as the
  current task zone set. This removes the X390-style retained task-area
  enrichment while the mower is at the dock.

## Canonical migration

Canonical v2 remains **shadow-only** in this beta. Beta3 is a field-validation
step for the new vendor-current semantics, not the public Canonical/Map API v2
authority cutover.

Test this as the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta3
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta3
